label: 0014 · Starter, 50 km BEL cut, remeshed BEL sheet, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_belcut50_unr on a remeshed 30 km BEL sheet with the same outline (2456 triangles with 30-69 km edges instead of 916 with 11-426 km edges; 2399 kept after the same cut under the forearc), still with 273 eigenmodes, which on this sheet keep 91% of the prior variance instead of 99%. Trench afterslip (Mw 8.39 at 2 yr), Nankai coupling and BEL slip near the stations are unchanged; the fit after Tohoku is about 5% worse, as fewer modes are spent where the data are. w005 keeps one chain (the other stalled and was dropped): new Noto mesh, UNR IGS20 positions, same 596 GEONET sites and windows
attribution: GNSS: GEONET daily positions, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI).
Coastline: Global Map Japan, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (地球地図日本・国土地理院).
Earthquakes: Global CMT catalog (Dziewonski et al., 1981; Ekström et al., 2012).
